nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: reflection balances, credited/debited on every transfer
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 allowances
mapping(address=>bool) bots: blacklist blocking transfers
mapping(address=>uint) cooldown: per-address timestamp gate written from block.timestamp
_rTotal: total reflections, reduced by fees in _reflectFee
_feeAddrWallet1: payable fee receiver and privileged caller of manualswap/manualsend
_feeAddrWallet2: payable fee receiver
uniswapV2Router: router instance used for swaps, liquidity and approvals
uniswapV2Pair: LP pair address used to detect buys/sells
inSwap: reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap
swapEnabled: enables automatic fee swap in _transfer
cooldownEnabled: enables the timestamp based cooldown gate
_maxTxAmount: maximum amount per buy transaction
_owner: privileged owner account checked by onlyOwner
_isExcludedFromFee: addresses exempt from fees/limits
constructor: sets fee wallets, mints _rTotal to deployer and marks exclusions
_transfer: core transfer logic, applies fees, cooldown, bot checks and triggers swaps
swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps contract tokens for ETH under lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee: splits contract ETH balance to the two fee wallets
openTrading: onlyOwner setup of router, pair, liquidity and limits
manualswap: fee wallet gated manual token-to-ETH swap
manualsend: fee wallet gated manual ETH distribution
blacklistBots: onlyOwner bulk blacklist of addresses
transfer: public ERC20 transfer entrypoint calling _transfer with msg.sender
transferFrom: public transferFrom calling _transfer then _approve allowance reduction
_transferStandard: computes r/t values and mutates _rOwned balances
_takeTeam: converts team fee to reflection and credits the contract
_reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal
_getValues: derives r/t amounts from fee rates and current rate
_approve: internal allowance writer with zero-address checks
setCooldownEnabled: onlyOwner toggles the cooldown feature
renounceOwnership: onlyOwner sets owner to zero address
delBot: onlyOwner removes an address from the blacklist
msg.sender / _msgSender(): externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time used for cooldown and deadlines
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
native ETH transfer to payable fee wallets inside sendETHToFee
external call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding full contract balance
parameter 'from' of _transfer (sender address)
parameter 'to' of _transfer (recipient address)
parameter 'amount' of _transfer (transfer amount)
parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth
parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee
parameter 'sender' of _transferStandard
parameter 'recipient' of _transferStandard
parameter 'tAmount' of _transferStandard
local contractTokenBalance computed from balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer
local currentRate from _getRate() used in _takeTeam
parameter 'bots_' array of blacklistBots
parameter 'onoff' of setCooldownEnabled
parameter 'spender' of _approve
parameter 'amount' of _approve
parameter 'notbot' of delBot

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as 'from' into _transfer and drives bot/cooldown/fee exclusion checks
block.timestamp is compared and written in the cooldown branch of _transfer
cooldown[to] is set to block.timestamp + 30 seconds, creating timestamp dependence
block.timestamp is forwarded as the router swap deadline
block.timestamp is forwarded as the addLiquidityETH deadline
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call
lockTheSwap toggles inSwap while the swap executes
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after the swap
sendETHToFee performs two native ETH transfers
ETH transfer to fee wallets can re-enter receive()/_transfer before the outer call finalizes
_transfer delegates accounting to _tokenTransfer which calls _transferStandard
_transferStandard subtracts/ adds _rOwned for sender and recipient
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the reflection team fee
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn the fee from reflections
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee via SafeMath sub
_getValues derives r/t transfers using values derived from _rTotal
openTrading stores the router instance in uniswapV2Router
openTrading creates and stores the LP pair in uniswapV2Pair
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH forwarding address(this).balance
onlyOwner checks _owner before openTrading executes
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
constructor assigns the entire _rTotal supply to msg.sender
transfer uses _msgSender() as the originating account
transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping
onlyOwner guards blacklistBots
onlyOwner guards setCooldownEnabled
onlyOwner guards delBot
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership
_msgSender() is used as spender in _approve from transferFrom
blacklistBots writes the bots mapping for arbitrary addresses
delBot clears the bots flag of an address
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to skip limits/fees
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering the swap
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled before applying the cooldown
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount buy limit
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair
_transfer guards the swap path with the inSwap flag

sendETHToFee sends half the balance to _feeAddrWallet2
openTrading enables swapEnabled
openTrading sets the _maxTxAmount limit

parameter 'to' is consumed by _transfer logic and cooldown mapping

parameter 'spender' is written into allowances in _approve
parameter 'amount' is written into allowances in _approve
parameter 'notbot' is cleared in the bots mapping by delBot
